## State Variables
### deployedAt
Timestamp when the contract was deployed

Used for tracking contract age and potential migrations


```solidity
uint256 public deployedAt
```


### rewardsToken
Token being distributed as rewards

Set at deployment and cannot be changed


```solidity
IERC20 public immutable rewardsToken
```


### roots
Mapping of distribution indices to their Merkle roots

Each distribution has a unique index and corresponding root hash


```solidity
mapping(uint256 index => bytes32 rootHash) public roots
```


### claimedRoots
Tracks which distributions have been claimed by each user

Uses bitmap for gas-efficient storage


```solidity
mapping(address user => BitMaps.BitMap claimedRoots) private claimedRoots
```

### canClaim

Checks if a user can claim from a distribution

    returns (bool);
